The “father of empiricism” is most widely recognised as Sir **Francis Bacon** (1561–1626).  
His father was **Sir Nicholas Bacon** (1510–1579), the English statesman who served as Lord Keeper of the Great Seal. Thus, the father of the father of empiricism is **Sir Nicholas Bacon**.
